summary: Federal Communications Commission urges preservation of E-Rate program to maintain broadband infrastructure for schools and libraries. Support for preserving E-Rate funding and infrastructure for educational access.

claims.argument: Reducing E-Rate would increase costs for school districts
claims.evidence_quote: If we didn't have e-rate, we'd have to ask even more from our local taxpayers whom we already rely on for essential services. It puts a big burden on rural communities.
